name: branch-agent
description: A local, inspectable personal assistant runtime

scripts.build: tsc && node scripts/copy-fonts.mjs && node scripts/copy-suites.mjs && node scripts/copy-data.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build && node dist/cli.js start
scripts.chat: npm run build && node dist/cli.js chat
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js demo
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build && node scripts/dependency-notices.mjs && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs
